nodes.name: StudySync webhook
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential must be named x-studysync-secret to match the header the app sends. Its value goes in the app as N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

nodes.name: Create plan page
nodes.notes: Your Plans database needs Type (select), Exam date (date) and Sessions (number) properties, and the integration must be shared with it.

nodes.name: Append plan body
nodes.notes: Batching is set to one item per batch on purpose: a plan over 100 blocks is split across several requests, and without serialising them Notion receives the batches out of order, so the page starts mid-plan.

nodes.name: One item per task
nodes.notes: A Split Out node cannot be used here: it only reads fields on its own input, which is the Notion page created upstream.

nodes.name: Create task row
nodes.notes: Owner is a TEXT property on purpose: Notion returns 400 for a select value that is not already an option, and group member names are not known up front. Priority and Status stay selects because their values are fixed.

nodes.name: Collapse to one
nodes.notes: Respond to Webhook must fire once; both branches can emit many items.
